what: Makefile `-k` shard filters are not updated alongside new pytest cases
scenario_or_breakage: CI runs `test-stall-recovery-report-{1,2,3}` via substring filters (`retry_policy`, `compose_report`, `dedup`, `validate_tier_b`, etc.). New redaction/dedup tests named outside those substrings (for example `test_public_dedup_signature_golden_vector`, `test_tier_b_create_fail_fallback`, `test_tier_a_issue_input_denied_forked`) would not run in harness shards after bash deletion
suggested_fix: Add an explicit Makefile subsection: update all three `-k '...'` expressions (or drop `-k` and partition by `@pytest.mark`) so every ported case24/case25/case23 contract test runs in CI
